title: Professional Engineering Services for Colbert County
short_description: Prequalification pool for on-call engineering services for grant applications and grant-funded projects.
project_scope: Request for statements of qualifications to establish a pool of pre-approved professional engineering vendors for a three-year period. The selected firms may be called upon as needed for grant applications and possible grant-funded projects. Requested disciplines include architecture services, civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, structural engineering, hydrology/hydraulics, and traffic design engineering. No specific project, structure type, size, span, or building area is defined.
services: On-call professional engineering services; prequalification/RFQ for architecture, civil, geotechnical, structural, hydrology/hydraulics, and traffic design engineering related to grant applications and potential grant-funded projects.
relevance_explanation:
- Framework-style pre-approved vendor pool without a defined technical project.
- No specific bridge, building, span, area, or special structure is identified.
- Includes broad multidisciplinary on-call services rather than a concrete structural design opportunity.
- Such framework agreements without technical specification are explicitly low priority for sbp.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated. The notice only concerns establishing a three-year pool of engineering consultants for future grant applications and possible grant-funded projects; no specific project scope, size, or budget is provided, so no realistic estimate is possible.
fee_explanation: No fee information is stated. Because this is only a prequalification pool for undefined future assignments, no realistic sbp fee estimate can be derived from the notice.
references_qualifications: Statements of qualifications from professional engineering companies are requested for inclusion in a pre-approved vendor pool. Specific minimum reference counts, project types, licenses, or qualification thresholds are not stated in the notice.
award_criteria: Not stated; the notice only indicates solicitation of statements of qualifications to establish a pre-approved vendor pool.
contracting_authority: Colbert County Commission, Tuscumbia, Alabama, USA. Contact: Jeremy Robison. Phone: 256-386-8546. Fax: 256-386-8510. Email: jrobison@colbertco.org.
notes: Target market is listed as General Building. Solicitation documents are available by contact. Funding source noted as grant fund. Stage: RFP/RFQ. No submission deadline set. This appears to be an on-call framework/prequalification arrangement rather than a defined project.
